name: youtube-extractor-microservice
description: High-performance low-latency YouTube audio stream extraction and download microservice for Aura Player

scripts.postinstall: node -e "if (process.platform !== 'win32' && !require('fs').existsSync('./yt-dlp')) { const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('curl -L https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp -o yt-dlp && chmod a+rx yt-dlp'); } catch(e){} }"
